label: Some necessary concrete holder of power for the actual contingents' joint absence varies its giving
paraphrase: Some concrete being exists at w, exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2 de re), has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w, and at some accessible world where it exists gives being (GivesTo) to not exactly the same beings as at w (GivingVariesAt). It is therefore not a one-way (fixed) giver. It asserts nothing about what decides the variation (choice, chance or an external condition), nor uniqueness, simplicity, firstness, intellect or God.
